content:
marta: Quick Q — product wants to keep a 7-day snippet of customer traces for 'session-replay-lite'. They say snippets may include identifiers. Is that allowed and who can sign off? cc @sanjay

sanjay: Short answer: probably, but only if properly redacted and TTL <= 7d. If any field is reversible (pseudonym -> real id) then it’s treated like PID. For TTL > 24h we need a retention-exception. What exact fields are they asking to keep?

marta: They listed: trace_id, timestamp, event_type, user_pseudonym (reversible), and a short action label. No full logs, but pseudonym is reversible. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/AI-4823

olivia: Infra can support a "slim" index and enforce a TTL. Reminder: redaction must happen pre-index. Example config we can apply as a transform:
```
index: traces-lite
transform: remove_fields(['raw_log', 'email', 'full_stack'])
map: redact_fields(['user_pseudonym'])
ttl_days: 7
```
We'd run the redact lambda before ingestion.

ben: Legal view: if pseudonym is reversible, treat as personal data. Product must submit business justification + risk mitigation. We won't sign off without the retention-exception form and the minimal-fields justification. Also need the data-flow diagram recorded.

sanjay: Proposed action flow: 1) Product fills retention-exception form with fields + justification. 2) Infra implements slim index + pre-index redaction. 3) Sec does a code review of the redaction hook and verifies no raw logs are stored. 4) Legal signs off and we record the approval. I'll draft a checklist.

sec-bot: Automated note: Per retention policy v2.1, any storage of PII/pseudonymizable data >24h requires a documented exception. See /policies/data-retention.md and submit via /forms/retention-exception.

marta: Thanks — I'll ask product to update AI-4823 with the justification, list of fields, and a data-flow diagram. @olivia can you provision a staging slim index I can use to validate redaction?

olivia: Yep. I'll provision `staging/traces-lite/marta` and share short-lived creds + an ingest example. ETA: today EOD.

ben: I'll review the justification once it's posted. Ping me in the ticket.

sanjay: I'll put together a short PR template for the pre-index redaction and tests (unit + integration). Ping me once infra has the staging index and creds.

marta: Great — I'll loop product in and update the ticket. Thanks all :thumbsup:
